description: Watermark golden vectors — the shared seed for cross-language agreement (F#/C#/TS/Rust). The event-time watermark of Akidau et al. (The Dataflow Model, VLDB 2015); the Beam/Flink primitive. All int64, no floats — byte-lockable in the safe-integer range. observe = the WatermarkTracker fold: maxSeen = running max of event times; emitted candidate = maxSeen (monotonic) or maxSeen - lateness (bounded; same formula Periodic uses), clamped monotone non-decreasing. isLate(wm, e) = e <= wm. combine = min across sources (an operator can't progress past its slowest input).
